DESCRIPTION:
Manage GGUF models from HuggingFace Hub.

USAGE:
    dotllm model [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm model search llama --limit 5
    dotllm model pull TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF --file llama-2-7b.Q4_K_M.gguf
    dotllm model info TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF
    dotllm model delete Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF
    dotllm model add C:\models\my-finetune.gguf --name my-finetune

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    search <query>               Search HuggingFace for GGUF models             
    pull <repo-id>               Download a GGUF model from HuggingFace         
    list                         List locally downloaded models                 
    info <repo-id>               Show details for a HuggingFace model repository
    delete <model>               Delete a locally downloaded model, or a model  
                                 profile                                        
    add <source>                 Add a local .gguf file (linked, not copied) or 
                                 download one from a URL                        
    create <name>                Create a named model profile: a base model plus
                                 system prompt, sampling defaults, device and   
                                 keep-alive                                     
    import-ollama                Import models from an existing ollama          
                                 installation as profiles (blobs are used in    
                                 place, nothing is copied)                      
    show <model>                 Show a profile's settings and where its model  
                                 resolves                                       
    cp <source> <destination>    Copy a profile, or alias a model under a new   
                                 profile name

    dotllm run <model> [OPTIONS]

    <model>    Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID (e.g.,                
               QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF)                                   

OPTIONS:
                                  DEFAULT                                       
    -h, --help                               Prints help information            
    -v, --version                            Prints version information         
        --kv-quant-k                         KV-cache key storage: f16, q8_0,

                                             For the CUDA hybrid-dense model    
                                             (Bonsai-2 / qwen35) overrides      
                                             DOTLLM_HYBRID_KV; quantized KV     
                                             needs numKvHeads*headDim % 32 == 0

                                             q4_0. Synonym of --cache-type-v.   
                                             See --kv-quant-k                   
    -p, --prompt                             Input prompt for generation.       
                                             Required unless --prompt-file is   
                                             given                              
        --prompt-file                        Read the prompt from a file instead
                                             of --prompt. A single trailing     
                                             newline is stripped. Mutually      
                                             exclusive with --prompt            
    -n, --max-tokens              128        Maximum number of tokens to

DESCRIPTION:
Benchmark prefill/decode throughput (llama-bench equivalent).

USAGE:
    dotllm bench <model> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm bench QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF --device cpu -p 512 -n 128 -r 5

ARGUMENTS:
    <model>    Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID (e.g.,                
               QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF)                                   

OPTIONS:
                              DEFAULT                                           
    -h, --help                           Prints help information                
    -v, --version                        Prints version information             
        --kv-quant-k                     KV-cache key storage: f16, q8_0, q4_0. 
                                         Synonym of --cache-type-k. For the CUDA
                                         hybrid-dense model (Bonsai-2 / qwen35) 
                                         overrides DOTLLM_HYBRID_KV; quantized  
                                         KV needs numKvHeads*headDim % 32 == 0  
        --kv-quant-v                     KV-cache value storage: f16, q8_0,     
                                         q4_0. Synonym of --cache-type-v. See   
                                         --kv-quant-k                           
    -d, --device              auto       Compute device: 'auto' (default: CUDA  
                                         if the model fits, else Vulkan, else   
                                         CPU - with a warning if it ends on the 
                                         CPU), 'cpu', 'vulkan', 'gpu'/'cuda',   
                                         'gpu:1'/'cuda:1'. An explicit GPU that 
                                         cannot be honoured is an error, never a
                                         silent CPU run                         
    -p, --prompt-tokens       512        Synthetic prompt length in tokens      
                                         (tiled from the seed prompt)           
    -n, --gen-tokens          128   
[truncated]

                                                    with --system

                                                    generate per response       
    -t, --temp                           0          Sampling temperature. 0 =   
                                                    greedy (default)

        --top-p                          1          Top-P (nucleus) sampling    
                                                    threshold                   
        --min-p                          0          Min-P sampling threshold. 0 
                                                    = disabled                  
        --repeat-penalty                 1          Repetition penalty factor.

DESCRIPTION:
Print embeddings (JSON Lines) for text using a GGUF embedding model (CPU).

USAGE:
    dotllm embed <model> [text] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm embed nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5-GGUF hello world --dimensions 
256

ARGUMENTS:
    <model>    Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID                       
    [text]     Text(s) to embed. When omitted, one input per line is read from  
               stdin                                                            

OPTIONS:
                          DEFAULT                                               
    -h, --help                       Prints help information                    
    -v, --version                    Prints version information                 
    -q, --quant                      Quantization to select when <model> is a   
                                     HuggingFace repo                           
        --pooling                    Pooling override: last, mean or cls.       
                                     Default: the model's declared pooling      
        --dimensions                 Truncate to the leading N components       
                                     (Matryoshka), then renormalise             
        --no-normalize               Return un-normalised vectors               
        --threads         0          CPU threads (0 = auto)

ARGUMENTS:

                                    DEFAULT

    -f, --corpus                                      Path to a UTF-8 text      
                                                      corpus (e.g.              
                                                      wiki.test.raw)            
        --normalize-line-endings                      Collapse CRLF to LF while 
                                                      reading --corpus, as MSVC 
                                                      text mode does. OFF by    
                                                      default. Use ONLY when the
                                                      reference figure came from
                                                      a Windows llama.cpp build 
                                                      reading the same CRLF     
                                                      file; llama.cpp on Linux  
                                                      keeps the CRs, so         
                                                      normalizing there creates 
                                                      a mismatch. Preferred fix 
                                                      is an LF corpus (see      
                                                      docs/PERPLEXITY.md, issue 
                                                      #506)                     
    -c, --context
